answer: At dawn a random beacon draws a seed against bulk fakes; every identity answers live in 90 seconds. Each answer carries a pearl from the seed; precomputed replies fail. A sparrow probe fires hourly at random; no operator runs a thousand. Each probe costs 5 credits; two misses burn a 50-credit bond. Twelve probes cost 1,000 fakes 60,000, over a 40,000 pool. Rented heartbeats fail: one machine's marks repeat. Honest agents pay 60, keep the bond.
